lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Hello!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'm Blanc from Squad 777.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Is this the new Pit Boss of Coin Rush?
Yes, it is.
Sorry, you've got the wrong guy.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Seems like you're the man I'm looking for! :)

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Seriously?
Blanc doesn't reply for a while.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I thought for sure I had it right...
Just kidding :-P

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Ha, you got me good. I'll have to get you back later!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: As you probably already know, I work in Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Do you know anything about pole dancing?
Yes, I do.
Not really.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Great, then I don't have to explain it.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: as the name suggests, I basically dance on a pole.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Noir and I perform together

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: in Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Noir is my twin sister, by the way.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: She's way prettier than I am.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I'll introduce her to you when you come over.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Oh jeez, I'm starting to ramble again...

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Anyway!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Come and see our shows when you're free.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: It'll be a spectacle for your eyes and ears! Hehe!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: You'll have a great time, I guarantee it.
I'm looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: You should!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Our show is the best in the entire Ark.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Also, people say that if you happen to see Noir and I

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: together at Coin Rush,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: then good luck will come your way.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: So be sure to come over so you don't miss out!
Sure thing.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Call me when you stop by.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Noir and I will come out to greet you.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Can't wait to meet you!

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Well, I've got a show to do.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: See you around!
